grammar_card.title: 现在的两种时态(用本课句子看懂它)
grammar_card.intro: 本课要分清两种"现在":经常做的事,还是此刻正在做的事。下面全用本课句子举例。

headers: 什么时候用 · 本课例子
rows: 一般现在时(动词原形 / 第三人称 +s)
说经常、习惯、每天的事:I never get up early on Sundays.(周日从不早起=习惯)
一般现在时也说客观事实
The sun rises in the east.(太阳东升=永远的事实)
说此刻正在做的事:I'm having breakfast.(此刻正在吃)
现在进行时也说近期安排
I'm coming over tonight.(近期打算来=已安排好)

specialRules.rule: V-ing 拼写:一般直接加 -ing;去掉不发音的 e(have→having);重读闭音节末尾单辅音字母双写(run→running);ie→y(lie→lying)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why is the writer's aunt surprised?
options: He is still having breakfast at one o'clock
He is late for the train

passage: It was Sunday, and I was still fast asleep. I never get up early on Sundays — I usually stay in bed until noon. That morning it was raining, and it was dark outside. "What a lazy Sunday!" I thought. Then my cell phone rang. It was my aunt Kate; I'm her only nephew, so she calls me every weekend. "I just arrived by train," she said. "I'm coming over to see you right now!" "But I'm still having breakfast," I said. "Breakfast? What are you doing?" she asked. "I'm having breakfast," I repeated. "Oh my!" she said. "Do you always get up this late? It's already one o'clock!" For me, breakfast is the first meal of the day — even at lunchtime.
